RequireCanonical.title: requireCanonical
RequireCanonical.description: Whether a block that is not on the canonical chain is acceptable. A JSON boolean; the JSON strings `"true"` and `"false"` are also accepted. Any other value is rejected with `-32602`. It is only consulted alongside `blockHash`; when it is true and the referenced block is not on the canonical chain, the node answers with a block-not-found error stating the block is not canonical.
